subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Gandhiji spent many years _______ Sabarmati Ashram.
solution:
The correct answer is **At**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **At**.
 
• The **At** is a proposition which we can use for **referring to specific areas in cities or the countryside, the preposition 'at' is employed.**
 
 
• **​Examples- *We often have lunch at the docks****.*
 
• ***He told me he would be at the bus stop at three o'clock.***
 
 
 
• Thus the correct answer is **At.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​With - With is used in a number of expressions that say how people express their emotions and sensations.​​
 
 
• **Examples**- *The old woman was shivering with cold.*
 
 
 
• By - When “by” is used as a preposition of place before a place, it means “beside” / “at the side of” / “next to”.
 
 
• **Examples- ***We live by an airport.*
 
 
 
• **​AT - W**ith particular points on the clock we can use AT.
 
 
• **Example-** I’ll see you at five o’clock.
